content_blocks.heading: What is a major chord?
content_blocks.body: A major triad contains a root, major third and perfect fifth.

content_blocks.heading: How to use this chart
content_blocks.body: Choose a root, read the chord tones, then open a detail page to compare root position and inversions. Octave numbers describe register; finger numbers are a separate concept.
